brief:
Pro-Palestine activists smeared red paint on a Danish defence company in a coordinated protest action, according to Al Jazeera English. The group targeted the firm's premises to oppose its military-sector operations and defence contracts.

The incident marks the latest in a series of demonstrations by pro-Palestine organizations against companies involved in weapons manufacturing and defence industries. Activists have increasingly adopted paint-based protests as a tactic to publicize their opposition to military suppliers. Such actions typically aim to generate public attention and pressure corporate entities to reconsider their business activities in the defence sector.
dek: Pro-Palestine activists smear red paint on Danish defence company.
title: Pro-Palestine activists paint Danish defence firm with red paint.
